item.title: Staccato HD C4X: Compact Carry, Full-Throttle Performance
item.description: Staccato has never been shy about building pistols for people who actually use them. At SHOT Show, the Texas-based brand pulled the curtain back on its newest flagship addition to the Staccato HD lineup: the Staccato HD C4X. Think of it as a duty gun that learned how to dress down, slip under a cover garment, and still absolutely handle business. The HD C4X is a compact carry pistol built on the proven 2011 platform, the same DNA trusted by elite law enforcement units and hard-use professionals

item.description: There are few items as important on a defensive handgun as a good weapon light. It is critical to identify a target in low-light conditions. item.title: Lawful Exercise of Rights Should Not Cost a Life: Our Response to Alex Pretti’s Death
item.description: On January 24, 2026, Alex Pretti was shot and killed by Federal Agents during a protest in Minnesota. Videos of the killing have been widely circulated on news and social media. By all accounts, he was exercising his 2nd Amendment Right as a lawful gun owner to lawfully carry his handgun. By all accounts he was doing so while lawfully exercising his 1st Amendment Right to peaceably assemble.
